[ 5. Passport Number ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructionscorr.html#08)
If applicant is Non-resident/Resident but not ordinarily resident, Passport Number is mandatory. [ 6. Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) in the Country of Residence ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructionscorr.html#09)
It is mandatory to provide TIN for an individual not being Citizen of India. [ 7. Contact Details ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructionscorr.html#10)
  * It is mandatory for the applicants to mention their "Mobile Number" and "e-mail id". * Mobile Number should include Country Code (ISD Code) and Landline Number (if any) should include Country/ISD Code and Area/STD Code. (i) Mobile Number 9102511111 of India should be written as:  
| Country Code  |   | Mobile Number  |

 |   | 9  | 1  |

 |

(iii) Landline Number 011 23555705 of Delhi, India should be written as:

Where '91' is the ISD Code and '11' is the STD Code of Delhi, India. [ 8. Father' Name ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructionscorr.html#11)  
| (i)  | It is a mandatory field. Married woman applicant shall give her father's  
name and not husband's name. |  
| --- | --- |  
| (ii) To be filled as First Name/ Middle Name/Last Name. |  
[ 9. Mother's Name ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructionscorr.html#12)
To be filled as First Name/ Middle Name/Last Name. [ 10. Parent Name to be printed on the PAN card ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructionscorr.html#13)
It is mandatory to select one of the parents' whose name is to be printed on the PAN card.
